documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On November 03, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive Limited reported its financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, registering its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. Consolidated net revenue grew by 47.5% year-on-year for Q2 FY27, driven by volume growth and the passthrough impact of significant alloy price increases, alongside strategic reductions in wheel assembly sales. The company commenced commercial production of alloy wheels and operationalized a new 11.55 MWp captive solar power plant in Rajasthan. Management highlighted ongoing technical collaborations, diverse product segments across braking, aluminium lightweighting, and safety control cables, and strong long-standing relationships with OEM customers. ASK Automotive Limited reported consolidated revenue growth of 52.1% year-on-year in Q1 FY27, achieving its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT.

guidance.claim: Management revised full-year revenue growth guidance for ASK Automotive from mid-teens to high teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: The company maintains its guidance of achieving a 20% growth in exports for the year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: Management expects the Karoli plant to achieve Rs. 1,500 crore in turnover next year.
guidance.quote: Next year, it should give us Rs. 1,500 crore turnover.

demand_outlook.claim: Total vehicle production across all segments in India grew 22.1% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 according to SIAM.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall vehicle production across all segments registered a robust year-on-year growth of 22.1% in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Two-wheeler production in India grew 22.8% year-on-year to 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: The easing monsoon deficit supports the outlook for rural incomes and two-wheeler demand ahead of the festive season.
demand_outlook.quote: The monsoon deficit witnessed earlier in the season has eased on the back of rainfall in late June and early July, supporting the outlook for rural income and two-wheeler demand in the run-up to the festive season.

demand_outlook.claim: ASK Automotive's revenue growth outperformed the broader industry growth in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of alloy wheels commenced on August 3, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Regular supply of High Pressure Die Casted (HPDC) Alloy Wheel commenced on 3rd August 2026 to our leading Japanese customer under technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan.

capex_expansion.claim: A captive solar power plant of 11.55 MWp in Rajasthan was operationalised in October 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Captive Solar power plant of 11.55 MWp in Rajasthan operationalised in Oct-26.

capex_expansion.claim: ASK Automotive's second captive solar plant of 11.55 MW at Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a new plant in Bangalore and aims to operationalize it before March of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: ASK Automotive has increased its FY27 capex guidance to approximately Rs. 700 crore from Rs. 450-500 crore earlier.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been implemented at the Karoli plant, and initial supplies of high-pressure die cast alloy wheels have commenced.
capex_expansion.quote: We are happy to share that the technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at our Karoli plant, and first supply of high-pressure die cast alloy wheel has started to our esteemed Japanese customer.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operationalized a 9.9 MWp captive solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

capex_expansion.claim: ASK Automotive successfully implemented its technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan at its Karoli plant and started supplies of alloy wheels to a Japanese customer.
capex_expansion.quote: Happy to share that the technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at our Karoli plant and 1st Supply of High Pressure Die Casted Alloy Wheel has started to our leading Japanese customer.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated net revenue growth was impacted by the passthrough of significant increase in alloy prices.
margins_costs.quote: Passthrough impact of Significant increase in Alloy Prices on revenue + 27.1%

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 EBITDA margins stood at 11.8%.
ASK Automotive achieved Q1 FY27 EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with an EBITDA margin of 12%.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with 32.7% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin stood at 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects overall EBITDA margins to settle between 13.5% and 14%.
margins_costs.quote: The overall margins you will be finding at around 13.5% to 14% in between that.

margins_costs.claim: Absolute EBITDA growth was driven by higher volume-related economies of scale.
margins_costs.quote: Higher Volume driven economies of scale

orders_capacity.claim: Wheel assembly sales were nil with effect from April 1, 2026.
The company has confirmed alloy wheel orders worth Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore in FY27 and about Rs. 250 crore for next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Export revenue from Ford Motors is expected to reach Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and Rs. 60 crore next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Karoli plant capacity utilization increased to about 75% in Q1 FY27 and is expected to reach around 80% in Q4.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Bangalore plant, which was our 18th plant, is running at near optimum capacity utilization and happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization, because we see the visibility for the Q4.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved absolute EBITDA improvements from increasing capacity utilization at its Karoli plant and new Bangalore facility.
orders_capacity.quote: Benefit from increasing capacity utilisation at Karoli and new Bangalore facility

orders_capacity.claim: Wheel Assembly sales became nil following the strategic closure of the segment with effect from April 1, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: With effect from 01.04.2026, WA Sales are Nil

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to reinvest internal accruals into expansion while maintaining a debt-to-equity ratio below 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: The philosophy of the company is to completely plow back the internal accruals. We'll be plowing that back, and wherever whether working capital, term loan need arises, we'll take the loan. We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt levels increased in Q1 FY27 due to higher working capital requirements from commodity price inflation.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, it has increased, because due to sudden increase in working capital requirement due to commodity price increase, so there is an increase in debt.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia led to volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, causing a sharp rise in aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

management_commitments.claim: ASK Automotive expects full-year revenue growth in high teens for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

management_commitments.claim: The 11.55 MW solar power plant at Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: ASK Automotive expects to operationalize a new plant in Bangalore before March in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management estimates FY27 capex to reach around Rs. 700 crore.
management_commitments.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
